# play { #timetoalign.timelines.play }

```python
timelines.play(
    registry,
    length,
    *,
    convention=FlowConvention.default,
    believer=None,
    beliefs=DEFAULT_BELIEFS,
)
```

Play flow control over an axis of *length*.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                                                                                                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Default                  |
|------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------|
| registry   | [FlowControlView](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.FlowControlView`)                                | The flow control.                                                                                                                                                                                                     | _required_               |
| length     | [_Number](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.engine._Number`) \| [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) | The length of the axis: a coordinate on the registry's axis, or a bare number on a bound registry.                                                                                                                    | _required_               |
| convention | [FlowConvention](`timetoalign.core.enums.FlowConvention`) \| [str](`str`)                             | ``default`` (every Jump and Break acts), ``single`` (once through) or ``printed`` (the axis as it stands).                                                                                                            | `FlowConvention.default` |
| believer   | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                                  | The actor whose beliefs alone decide which elements are read (:meth:`FlowControlView.active_elements <timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.FlowControlView.active_elements>`); None reads the elements no actor rejects. | `None`                   |
| beliefs    | [Collection](`collections.abc.Collection`)\[[BeliefState](`timetoshare.BeliefState`)\]                | With a believer, the belief states read; every state but ``"false"`` by default.                                                                                                                                      | `DEFAULT_BELIEFS`        |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                         | Description                                                       |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [FlowResult](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.engine.FlowResult`) | The runs in the order played and the findings. ``default`` and    |
|        | [FlowResult](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.engine.FlowResult`) | ``single`` find a flow that never ends, a flow ending at a Break, |
|        | [FlowResult](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.engine.FlowResult`) | destinations not determined or holding together, and the          |
|        | [FlowResult](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.engine.FlowResult`) | stretches never played; ``printed`` finds nothing. A stretch      |
|        | [FlowResult](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.engine.FlowResult`) | ``single`` never plays that the ``default`` flow plays has the    |
|        | [FlowResult](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.engine.FlowResult`) | cause ``single_playback``; every other finding has none.          |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|--------|----------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the length is negative or not on the registry's axis, or the elements read cannot be played, in the words the registry refuses an element with: a ``to`` or an ``after`` names an element that is not read (a rejected one names nothing), two of the Jumps read lie at one coordinate (a rejected Jump and its replacement, read for a believer who rejects neither), or an element, or the place a destination goes on at, lies before 0 or beyond the length. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from timetoalign.core import Coordinate
>>> from timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol import (
...     FlowControlRegistry, Jump, JumpDestination)
>>> registry = FlowControlRegistry(unit="quarters")
>>> _ = registry.add(
...     Jump(Coordinate(8, "quarters"), [JumpDestination(repeat_count=1)]))
>>> [str(run) for run in play(registry, 12).runs]
['[0, 8) quarters', '[0, 12) quarters']
>>> [str(run) for run in play(registry, 12, convention="single").runs]
['[0, 12) quarters']
```

Going through once takes the second of two brackets at once:

```python
>>> from timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol import JumpTarget
>>> brackets = FlowControlRegistry(unit="quarters")
>>> _ = brackets.add_all([
...     Jump(Coordinate(4, "quarters"), [
...         JumpDestination(by=0, passes=[1]),
...         JumpDestination(to="second", passes=[2])]),
...     JumpTarget(Coordinate(8, "quarters"), id="second"),
...     Jump(Coordinate(8, "quarters"), [JumpDestination(repeat_count=1)])])
>>> [(str(f.kind), str(f.coordinate), str(f.end), str(f.cause))
...  for f in play(brackets, 12, convention="single").findings]
[('never_played', '4 quarters', '8 quarters', 'single_playback')]
```
